attributes.action: Counter protest allowing Marilyn Manson to perform at Wembley stadium 2027 in UK
attributes.additional_details:
I believe that no artist , including Marilyn Manson should be prevented from performing at an event where the majority of petitioners against him performing in 2027 have no intent or interest in attending his performance. 

The words of the few should not overthrow the chants of the majority. 

Manson has played several arenas and performances across the United kingdom in 2026 and it seems discriminate and opportunistic to attempt and prevent him from performing this year.
attributes.background:
We believe that the petition presented against Marilyn Manson to prevent him performing at the Wembley Stadium alongside Slipknot in 2027 should be revoked due to hearsay and its inaccuracies. 
Marilyn Manson already performed at several venues in the United Kingdom in 2026 with no protest.

rejection.details: Our e-petitions system does not contain any petition against Marilyn Manson, nor would we allow one as we do not accept petitions on individual cases.
